pd_sisters_2.summary: Kuligin teases the drunken Chebutikin, patting him on the shoulder.
Tuzenbach proposes Masha play a charity concert; Kuligin hesitates over propriety.
Vershinin reports the brigade may be transferred; Irina vows they will leave too.
Chebutikin drops their mother's clock, smashing it, and shrugs off the guilt nihilistically.
At the door Chebutikin blurts out Natasha's affair with Protopopov, then exits singing.
Vershinin recounts finding his frightened daughters during the fire and his angry wife.
As Masha enters, Vershinin philosophizes about how future centuries will judge their lives.

pd_sisters_3.summary: Anfisa joyfully describes her happy old age living in Olga's school apartment.
Vershinin must leave and asks for Masha; Irina and Anfisa go search the garden.
Vershinin bids Olga farewell; they admit they will probably never meet again.
Olga laments her failed plans and lost Moscow; Vershinin asks forgiveness, she weeps.
Waiting for Masha, Vershinin philosophizes about mankind's future while checking his watch.
Masha arrives; Olga steps aside as Vershinin and Masha say good-bye.

pd_sisters_4.summary: Trofimov appears impatiently to greet Lubov, who does not recognize him at first.
Recognizing her drowned son's tutor, Lubov embraces Trofimov and weeps for Grisha.
Lubov composes herself and gently remarks how old Trofimov has grown, then heads for bed.
Pischin begs 240 roubles for his mortgage; Lubov makes Gaev lend it.
Left behind, Gaev grumbles about his sister's spending and snubs the grinning Yasha.

pd_sisters_5.summary: Charlotta performs shawl tricks revealing Anya and Varya, then flings it at Pischin.
Lubov anxiously awaits news of the estate sale; Varya insists Gaev has bought it.
Trofimov teases Varya about Lopakhin; she snaps back angrily at him.
Lubov urges Varya to marry Lopakhin; Varya confesses he never proposes and dreams of a convent.
Yasha reports Epikhodov broke a billiard cue; Varya storms off in irritation.
Lubov rebukes Trofimov for teasing; he complains Varya meddles and claims they are above love.

pd_sisters_6.summary: Varya waves an umbrella, startling Lopakhin, as everyone prepares to leave.
Trofimov rushes everyone to the train; Varya tearfully hands him old goloshes.
Lopakhin locks up; Anya and Trofimov greet new life as everyone files out.
Alone, Lubov and Gaev sob in each other's arms, bidding the orchard farewell.
They go; doors lock, carriages depart, and an axe strikes the trees.
Ill Fiers finds himself locked in and forgotten, lies down, and falls still.
